column1: # Curated genome panel for the Bakta/Prokka disagreement experiment.
# Chosen to spread GC content (~28-72%) across several phyla, one genome per
# species. GC and phylum breadth matter because GC is a candidate feature: a
# panel drawn from one clade would confound "GC" with "this lineage".
# Mollicutes (Mycoplasma, Ureaplasma) are deliberately excluded. They use
# genetic code 4, not 11, which would require per-genome translation-table
# handling in both annotators and turn a uniform comparison into a
# conditional one. That is a real omission, recorded rather than hidden.
# expected_gc is approximate, from literature, and is NOT used by the
# pipeline. Observed GC is computed from the downloaded sequence in
# results/metrics/01_genomes.json. The column exists so the panel's spread
# can be reviewed before several hours of annotation are spent on it.
